usermeta.title: Victoria is the centre of dairy farming
usermeta.finding: Victoria holds 65.6% of Australia’s registered dairy farms.

description: Victoria holds 65.6% of Australia’s registered dairy farms. Left: complete geographic reference, including NT and ACT. Right: six reported state silhouettes, resized with a common area-per-farm scale and arranged in rows for comparison. Shape area represents farms, not land. NT and ACT counts are not reported; they are not zeros.
